title: Libra: Assessing and Improving Reward Model by Learning to Think
authors_zh: Meng Zhou、Bei Li、Jiahao Liu、Xiaowen Shi、Yang Bai、Rongxiang Weng、Jingang Wang、Xunliang Cai
paper_type_zh: 数学推理奖励模型基准与训练方法
best_for_zh: 需要评测或训练能够判断复杂数学推理正确性的奖励模型的研究者
one_line: Libra Bench turns difficult mathematical reasoning outputs into a 3,740-record correctness benchmark for training and testing thinking reward models.
Libra-Bench 提供约 3,740 条数学推理偏好样本，要求奖励模型先形成评判推理再排序，直接服务于 RM 训练与推理时选择。
why: It makes reward-model reasoning itself observable through labelled judgments of difficult model-generated solutions.
inclusion_reason: Libra Bench releases reward-model supervision that tests whether a judge can assess the correctness of difficult reasoning outputs.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Most reward-model benchmarks use pairwise preferences from general question answering and do not test whether a model can judge the actual correctness of advanced reasoning-model outputs on difficult mathematics. Rule rewards also depend on reference answers and constrained output formats, limiting scaling to unlabeled reasoning data.

The paper converts verifiable reasoning into verifiable judging through its V2V strategy to build Libra Bench, then uses related data with rejection sampling, SFT, and rule-reward RL to train thinking-capable Libra-RM models.

现有奖励模型基准多用一般问答的成对偏好，难以检验模型能否判断先进推理模型在高难数学题上的真实正确性；依赖参考答案和固定输出格式的规则奖励也限制了无标注推理数据扩展。

论文以“可验证推理转为可验证评判”的 V2V 策略构建 Libra Bench，并用同类数据通过拒绝采样、SFT 与规则奖励 RL 训练具有长思考能力的 Libra-RM。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper converts verifiable reasoning into verifiable judging through its V2V strategy to build Libra Bench, then uses related data with rejection sampling, SFT, and rule-reward RL to train thinking-capable Libra-RM models. Libra Bench contains 3,740 English records from 204 MATH-500 Level-5, AIME 2024, and AIME 2025 problems and five reasoning models. Fields include question, response, binary label, generator model, reference, subset, and response_with_cot; the release uses the MIT licence.

论文以“可验证推理转为可验证评判”的 V2V 策略构建 Libra Bench，并用同类数据通过拒绝采样、SFT 与规则奖励 RL 训练具有长思考能力的 Libra-RM。Libra Bench 含 3,740 条英文样本，来自 204 道 MATH-500 Level 5、AIME 2024 和 AIME 2025 题目以及 5 个推理模型；字段包括 question、response、二值 label、generator model、reference、subset 和保留完整 CoT 的 response_with_cot，MIT 许可。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build the source pool: Collect 204 difficult mathematical questions with gold answers and divide them into MATH and two AIME subsets.
  1. Generate or reorganize feedback: Sample at least 64 responses per question from DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3-32B, QwQ-32B, and two R1-Distill models, covering both correct and incorrect outputs.
  1. Verify and filter: Assign correctness labels through answer matching, strong-model verification, and human review; remove malformed CoT-only records and balance positive and negative examples by generator.
  1. Train and evaluate: Form pointwise judging inputs from each question and response. Libra-RM training then applies label-consistent rejection sampling followed by RL with correctness reward and a length penalty.

1. 建立数据源： 收集 204 道带标准答案的高难数学题，并按 MATH 与两届 AIME 划分子集。
  1. 生成或重组反馈： 从 DeepSeek-R1、Qwen3-32B、QwQ-32B 和两个 R1-Distill 模型为每题采样至少 64 个回答，覆盖正确与错误输出。
  1. 验证与筛选： 用答案规则匹配、强模型复核和人工核验联合标注正确性，删除仅含截断 CoT 的异常记录，并平衡各模型的正负样本。
  1. 训练与评测： 将问题与候选回答组成 pointwise judging 输入；训练 Libra-RM 时再以标签一致性做拒绝采样，并用正确性奖励和长度惩罚进行 RL。

title: Evidence
证据
html: On Libra Bench, non-thinking models obtain roughly 55.1%–69.1% accuracy while thinking models reach 73.7%–78.7%, showing that the difficult responses separate judging capability. The paper also reports correlation with downstream BoN/RL selection and state-of-the-art results for Libra-RM on several RM benchmarks. These results support the central claim only under the released data, model scales, candidate budgets, and evaluation protocols; cross-domain use requires new validation.
Libra Bench 上非思考模型准确率约为 55.1%–69.1%，思考模型为 73.7%–78.7%，显示高难响应确实拉开评判能力差异；论文还报告基准得分与 BoN/RL 下游选择效果具有相关性，Libra-RM 在多项 RM 基准上达到当时最佳。 这些结果支持论文的核心主张，但只适用于其公开数据、模型规模、候选预算和评测协议；跨领域使用仍需重新验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior reasoning-reward benchmarks usually test pairwise ranking or step-error localization. Libra instead evaluates pointwise correctness of complete outputs from advanced reasoning models and reuses the same verifiable-judging contract for benchmark construction and thinking-oriented generative-RM training.
最接近的推理奖励基准通常评估成对排序或逐步错误定位；Libra 改为针对先进模型完整回答的 pointwise correctness 判断，并把同一“可验证判断”契约同时用于 benchmark 构造和生成式 RM 的思考训练。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Coverage boundary: The benchmark is concentrated on competition mathematics and does not directly represent writing, safety, or open-ended value judgments.
  1. Feedback risk: Binary correctness mainly verifies the final result; a correct conclusion may hide invalid intermediate reasoning, so response_with_cot requires separate process auditing.
  1. Reproduction and use: The MATH subset depends on model and human review; reuse should freeze annotation versions and inspect judge bias and contamination.

1. 覆盖边界： 领域集中在竞赛数学，不能直接代表通用写作、安全或开放式价值判断。
  1. 反馈风险： 二值正确标签主要验证最终答案；正确结论可能掩盖错误中间推理，response_with_cot 仍需另做过程审计。
  1. 复现与使用： MATH 子集依赖模型与人工复核，复用时应冻结标注版本并检查评判模型偏差和潜在基准污染。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluation: Use Libra Bench as a pointwise-correctness test for reasoning-oriented ORMs or generative RMs and report accuracy separately for its three subsets.
  1. Training: Train or calibrate a mathematical correctness RM from question, response, and label, then validate it through BoN correlation with a fixed policy.
  1. Transfer or deployment: Reuse the V2V pipeline in other verifiable domains only after establishing reliable answer extraction and human-review protocols.

1. 评测： 将 Libra Bench 用作推理型 ORM/GenRM 的 pointwise correctness 测试，并按三个子集分别报告准确率。
  1. 训练： 使用 question、response 与 label 训练或校准数学正确性奖励模型，再用固定 policy 做 BoN 相关性验证。
  1. 迁移或部署： 复用 V2V 流程为其他可验证领域构造 benchmark，但必须先建立可靠答案解析器和人工复核协议。
